## UPCOMING EVENTS

<!-- Code for auto events of current FIMS weekly -->
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: !expr "is.null(quarto::quarto_meta()$'upcoming-events'$'code-club') || is.null(quarto::quarto_meta()$'upcoming-events'$'seaside-chat') || is.null(quarto::quarto_meta()$'upcoming-events'$'additional-events')"

cal_id <- "c_6eluv1h8o830k7vt8ctcs6ghto@group.calendar.google.com"

# Define the 5-day window for events based on the document's date
doc_date <- tryCatch({
  as.Date(quarto::quarto_meta()$date)
}, error = function(e) {
  Sys.Date() # Fallback to current date if not in a Quarto doc with a date
})

start_of_week <- as.POSIXct(doc_date, tz = "America/New_York")
end_of_week <- start_of_week + lubridate::days(5)

# Fetch calendar data from the start of our week of interest
start_bound <- URLencode(format(start_of_week, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz="UTC"))
url <- paste0(
  "https://calendar.google.com/calendar/ical/", URLencode(cal_id), "/public/basic.ics",
  "?timeMin=", start_bound,
  "&maxResults=100",
  "&singleEvents=true"
)

tryCatch({
  tmp_ics <- tempfile(fileext = ".ics")
  
  # Download calendar file
  if (Sys.info()[["sysname"]] == "Windows") {
    download.file(url, destfile = tmp_ics, quiet = TRUE)
  } else {
    download.file(url, destfile = tmp_ics, quiet = TRUE, extra = "-L -k")
  }
  
  raw_lines <- readLines(tmp_ics, warn = FALSE)
  
  unfolded_text <- gsub("\n[ \t]", "", paste(raw_lines, collapse = "\n"))
  lines <- strsplit(unfolded_text, "\n")[[1]]
  
  event_starts <- which(lines == "BEGIN:VEVENT")
  event_ends   <- which(lines == "END:VEVENT")
  events_list <- list()
  
  # Helper function to extract a value from an iCal line
  extract_val <- function(p, l) { 
    line <- grep(p, l, value = TRUE)
    if (length(line) > 0) sub(p, "", line[1]) else "" 
  }
  
  # Robust time parser using lubridate to handle different timezone formats
  parse_ical_time <- function(raw_line) {
    if (is.null(raw_line) || !nzchar(raw_line)) return(NULL)
    
    # Case 1: Time with a TZID (e.g., DTSTART;TZID=America/New_York:20240728T120000)
    if (grepl("TZID=", raw_line)) {
      tzid <- sub(".*TZID=([^:]+):.*", "\\1", raw_line)
      time_str <- sub(".*:", "", raw_line)
      return(lubridate::ymd_hms(time_str, tz = tzid, quiet = TRUE))
    }
    
    time_str <- sub(".*:", "", raw_line)
    
    # Case 2: UTC time (e.g., DTSTART:20240728T160000Z)
    if (grepl("Z$", time_str)) {
      return(lubridate::ymd_hms(time_str, tz = "UTC", quiet = TRUE))
    }
    
    # Case 3: All-day event (e.g., DTSTART;VALUE=DATE:20240728)
    if (nchar(time_str) == 8 && !grepl("T", time_str)) {
      return(as.POSIXct(time_str, format = "%Y%m%d", tz = "UTC"))
    }
    
    # Fallback for local/floating times without TZID, treat as UTC
    return(lubridate::ymd_hms(time_str, tz = "UTC", quiet = TRUE))
  }

  if (length(event_starts) > 0) {
    for (i in seq_along(event_starts)) {
      ev_lines <- lines[event_starts[i]:event_ends[i]]
      
      start_time <- parse_ical_time(grep("^DTSTART", ev_lines, value = TRUE)[1])
      if (is.null(start_time)) next
      
      desc_text <- extract_val("^DESCRIPTION:", ev_lines)
      desc_text <- sub("(<br>|\\\\n|\\\\N|\\s)*(Join with Google Meet|Google Meet joining info|This event has a video call|Join Zoom Meeting|-::~:~::~:~:~).*$", "", desc_text, ignore.case = TRUE)
      desc_text <- trimws(gsub("(<br>|\\s)+$", "", gsub("\\\\;", ";", gsub("\\\\,", ",", gsub("\\\\n|\\\\N", "<br>", desc_text)))))
      
      events_list[[length(events_list) + 1]] <- list(
        summary = extract_val("^SUMMARY:", ev_lines), 
        start = start_time, 
        end = parse_ical_time(grep("^DTEND", ev_lines, value = TRUE)[1]), 
        description = desc_text,
        location = extract_val("^LOCATION:", ev_lines)
      )
    }
  }
  
  weekly_events <- Filter(function(x) x$start >= start_of_week && x$start < end_of_week, events_list)
  
  if (length(weekly_events) > 0) {
    weekly_events <- weekly_events[order(sapply(weekly_events, `[[`, "start"))]
    last_date_printed <- ""
    for (event in weekly_events) {
      # Group events under the same day header
      current_date_str <- format(event$start, "%A, %B %d", tz = "America/New_York")
      if (current_date_str != last_date_printed) {
        if (last_date_printed != "") cat("\n\n") # Add space between days
        cat(glue::glue('### {current_date_str}\n\n'))
        last_date_printed <- current_date_str
      } else {
        # It's a subsequent event on the same day, add a separator.
        cat("---\n\n")
      }
      
      cat(glue::glue('**{event$summary}**\n\n'))
      
      is_all_day <- format(event$start, "%H:%M:%S", tz="UTC") == "00:00:00" && (is.null(event$end) || as.Date(event$end) > as.Date(event$start))
      
      time_str <- if (is_all_day) "All day" else {
        start_et <- trimws(format(event$start, "%l:%M %p", tz="America/New_York"))
        start_pt <- trimws(format(event$start, "%l:%M %p", tz="America/Los_Angeles"))
        start_ht <- trimws(format(event$start, "%l:%M %p", tz="Pacific/Honolulu"))
        glue::glue("{start_et} ET / {start_pt} PT / {start_ht} HT")
      }
      cat(glue::glue('Time: {time_str}\n\n'))
      
      if (nzchar(event$description)) cat(glue::glue('{event$description}\n\n'))
    }
  } else {
    cat("No upcoming events scheduled for this week. Check the FIMS Community Calendar for more.")
  }
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("Could not retrieve calendar events. Please check the FIMS Community Calendar.")
})
```
